description: Compare two STEP part files (single parts, not assemblies) and say whether they are the same part. Use it when the user asks whether two CAD files differ, what changed between two versions of a part, or whether a part was only moved or mirrored. The files are read locally and never uploaded. Returns verdict (same / moved / different) and, when different, the changed features with sizes, e.g. {type: "through_hole", change: "modified", attr: "diameter", from: 6, to: 6.5, location: [150, 90, 10]}. Typical time: under a second for simple parts, 5–15 s for parts with several hundred faces. Multi-body parts (several solids in one file) need CAD Compare Pro; the free version returns license_required for them. Report warnings to the user; they say when the result needs care.

a.description: Absolute path to the first part file (A, usually the older version) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

b.description: Absolute path to the second part file (B) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

name: compare

method.description: How A was placed onto B before comparing

mirrored.description: B is a mirror image of A (left/right part), or also happens to be one after the change

rigid_motion_detected.description: A had to be moved or rotated to match B

transform.description: 4×4 row-major matrix that maps A onto B (identity when compared in place)

faces.description: Face counts of B by status; null unless the verdict is different

features.description: Feature-level changes, largest first; empty unless the verdict is different

attr.description: For modified: the size that changed (diameter, radius, depth, width, angle, height, length)

from.description: Value in A (mm, angles in degrees)

location.description: Where in B, mm (in A for removed)

offset.description: For moved: displacement from A to B, mm

size.description: For added, removed and moved: the feature's own sizes, e.g. {diameter: 6} (mm, angles in degrees; names as in attr)

type.description: What changed, e.g. through_hole, hole, fillet, chamfer, boss, pocket, slot, outer_diameter, face

bbox_a.description: Size of A along its principal axes, largest first, mm (independent of position)

max_deviation.description: Largest distance from A's surface to B's after alignment, mm

tolerance.description: Distance in mm below which surfaces count as identical (scales with part size)

unit.description: All lengths in millimetres; files in inches are converted

verdict.description: same: identical within the tolerance. moved: the same shape, but B is translated and/or rotated relative to A (often just a different coordinate system in the export). different: the shapes differ; see features.

warnings.description: Caveats to pass on to the user: unit_mistake_suspected (sizes differ by exactly 25.4 or 10×, probably a unit error), units_differ:<a>/<b> (files saved in different units), volume_approximate (freeform surfaces, volumes are estimates), face_diff_failed (verdict is reliable, the list of changes is missing), file_repaired:<A|B> (the file had edges stored the wrong way round, a known CAD export error; they were corrected before comparing), file_defective:<A|B> (the file contains defective geometry that could not be repaired; the result may be wrong, suggest checking or re-exporting the file), feature_details_require_pro (free version: the parts differ, but which features changed is only listed with CAD Compare Pro)
